name: Simple Machines
description: The machine parts of the Simple Machines tab: Double Piston (one block, two stages), Signal Dampener (takes 0-3 off the signal), and the piston upgrades - Reinforced (Sticky) Piston (pushes 18, one paid unbreakable), Netherite and Enderite Piston (break the block in front, with durability, repaired with their nugget), Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite Hopper (2/4/8 times as fast, item filter) and their hopper minecarts. Works on its own; the Enderite parts need Simple Ores.
